findingDetails.title: Parent spec reports Complete while phase 7 is Draft and its review rerun is unfinished
findingDetails.case: An operator or resume flow reads Status Complete and the handoff criteria, closes or merges the packet, and never runs phase 7's deep review rerun, so recursive strict validation for all seven children is never proven.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Status rows across all seven children return six Complete and one Draft; the parent phase map independently labels row 7 In Progress; only phase 7 has unticked verification boxes.
findingDetails.claim: The parent packet's completion record says Complete while phase 7 is Draft and its required review rerun is unfinished.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether Complete could mean only that the parent spec document is authored, and whether phase 7 was deliberately left open because this review iteration is its T011; the same metadata row's Handoff Criteria names all seven children as the completion condition, so neither reading resolves the contradiction.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The Status row was set when the packet had four phases and was not reverted when phases 5-7 were added; the phase 7 rerun is this generation's review.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If the Status field is documented as spec-authored rather than packet completion, or phase 7 becomes Complete with recorded evidence and T011 is closed, this is P2 record drift.

findingDetails.title: Parent spec still lists the Pi fallbacks and Vitest alias as out of scope after phases 5 and 6 fixed them

results.summary: Phases 1-6 outcomes match evidence (six paths absent, codex folder present, phase 4 records fixed, both sync checks PASS, README validators pass); phase 7 REQ-001 is contradicted by goal.md:108-111 and spec.md:52, and SC-002 is the in-progress rerun.
